mutations.name: the desktop table repeats a Stage column
kills: the tasks layout shows every stage in one table under a single header, with a group row per stage and no stage badge

mutations.name: a desktop wraps the filters onto stacked rows
kills: the tasks layout lays the filters out in one row on a desktop, the text filter taking the rest

mutations.name: a phone gets the desktop's one-row filters
kills: the tasks layout stacks the filters full width on a phone
